scope: CPU-native runtime admission, chronological tile execution, and process-tree resource characterization

timeline_cases.name: timeline_24h
timeline_cases.interpretation: same-day prepared fixture; candidate runtime characterization only

timeline_cases.name: timeline_96h
timeline_cases.interpretation: four consecutive copies of the 24-row forcing with advanced day-of-year and hour fields; no long-horizon original parity claim

timeline_cases.name: timeline_288h
timeline_cases.interpretation: twelve consecutive copies of the 24-row forcing with advanced day-of-year and hour fields; no long-horizon original parity claim

parallel_cases.tile_inputs: two independent copies of the same logical 32x35 tile and forcing
parallel_cases.comparison: descriptive elapsed time and sampled process-tree RSS only; no speedup gate

cache_cases.name: cold
cache_cases.policy: native geometry cache absent before execution

cache_cases.name: warm
cache_cases.policy: native geometry cache populated and identity-verified before execution
cache_cases.unavailable_label: not available until the integrated native cache exposes a verifiable manifest

measurement.process_tree_rss: sum root process and recursive descendants
measurement.elapsed: wall-clock process lifetime including imports, JIT compilation, geometry work, chronological execution, and output writing
measurement.first_use_and_warm_jit: not separated; no JIT or startup timing claim
measurement.budget_action: record and terminate a run that exceeds 4 GiB summed process-tree RSS; preserve failure evidence
measurement.shared_rss_caveat: summed resident sets can count shared pages more than once and samples can miss between-sample peaks
required_records: output inventory, dimensions, bands, and completion state

output_contract.conditional_output: SVF is recorded with its actual cold/warm write behavior
schema_checks: files exist only after successful completion
GeoTIFF dimensions equal the logical 32x35 tile
band count and Time metadata are recorded
no output history is retained solely for measurement

provenance.candidate_commit: record at execution; repository may be uncommitted
provenance.fixture_hash: hash every copied input and generated met file
provenance.environment: Python, package distributions, platform, CPU, GDAL, native thread variables
provenance.reference_hashes: upstream commit and small_original_cpu reference_manifest.json hash

interpretation_limits: These are characterization measurements, not release benchmarks or speed claims.
The 96-hour and 288-hour forcings repeat the 24-hour fixture and are not original-upstream parity cases.
A tiny 32x35 fixture may not resolve a history-memory slope; report that limitation explicitly.
Missing native cache, unavailable multi-tile integration, failed runs, and unavailable hardware remain explicit statuses, never passes.
